title: Prefab
description: A prefab file (§6.3): never contains Prefab or PrefabLink components.

Format.description: The file's format name; first key of the file.

Version.description: The format version this build writes; older versions are migrated when read.

Root.description: The id of the prefab's single root entity.

ComponentVersions.description: The version of every component type present, by registry name.

ID.description: The entity's persistent identity, written as the entity key "ID".
The entity's UUID; set at creation and never changed.

Name.description: The entity's display name, written as the entity key "Name".
The display name used by entity paths; names need not be unique.

Tags.description: The entity's gameplay tags, written as the entity key "Tags".
Free-form tags such as "Player"; non-empty, unique, in insertion order.

Relationship.description: The entity's place in the hierarchy; its parent is written as the entity key "Parent".

Parent.description: The parent entity; null for a root entity.

Transform.description: Positions, rotates and scales the entity relative to its parent.

Translation.description: Position relative to the parent, in metres.

Rotation.description: Rotation relative to the parent: a unit quaternion written [x, y, z, w].

Scale.description: Scale along the local axes; each component's magnitude is at least 0.0001.

Prefab.description: Marks the root of a prefab instance and records its overrides.
The prefab asset the instance was created from.

Overrides.description: The instance's differences from the prefab, sorted by prefab entity, component, kind and field.

PrefabLink.description: Links a prefab instance member, the root included, to its prefab entity.

PrefabEntityID.description: The prefab-local ID of the entity this member was created from.

InstanceRoot.description: The root entity of the instance, which has the Prefab component.

MeshRenderer.description: Draws a mesh asset with one material per submesh.

Mesh.description: The mesh to draw; null draws nothing.

Materials.description: One material per submesh; an empty list or a null slot uses the mesh's default material for that submesh.

ReceiveShadows.description: Whether shadows fall on the mesh.

Visible.description: Whether the mesh is drawn at all.

Camera.description: Renders the scene from the entity, looking down its local -Z axis.

VerticalFov.description: The vertical field of view of the perspective projection, in degrees.

OrthographicSize.description: Half the visible height of the orthographic projection, in metres.

NearClip.description: The near clipping distance, in metres; below FarClip.

FarClip.description: The far clipping distance, in metres; beyond it nothing is drawn or culled in.

Primary.description: Whether this is the scene's primary camera (exactly one active camera should be).

Clear.description: What the camera draws behind the scene.

ClearColor.description: The linear background colour when Clear is Color.

DirectionalLight.description: A sun-like light shining down the entity's local -Z axis.

Intensity.description: The unitless brightness multiplied with Color.

CastShadows.description: Whether the light casts cascaded soft shadows.

ShadowDistance.description: How far from the camera shadows reach, in metres.

CascadeCount.description: The number of shadow cascades, from 1 to 4.

CascadeSplitLambda.description: The cascade split blend from uniform (0) to logarithmic (1).

LightAngle.description: The angular diameter of the light source, in degrees; larger values soften shadow penumbrae.

DepthBias.description: The shadow depth bias, in shadow-map texels.

NormalBias.description: The shadow normal-offset bias, in shadow-map texels.

PointLight.description: A light shining in every direction from the entity (no shadows).

Intensity.description: The unitless brightness multiplied with Color.

Range.description: The distance at which the light's falloff reaches zero, in metres.

SourceRadius.description: The radius of the emitting sphere, in metres; widens highlights.

SpotLight.description: A cone of light shining down the entity's local -Z axis.

Intensity.description: The unitless brightness multiplied with Color.

Range.description: The distance at which the light's falloff reaches zero, in metres.

InnerConeAngle.description: The angle from the axis inside which the light is at full strength, in degrees; below OuterConeAngle.

OuterConeAngle.description: The angle from the axis at which the light fades to zero, in degrees.

CastShadows.description: Whether the light casts soft shadows (shadow atlas budget applies).

SourceRadius.description: The radius of the emitting disc, in metres; widens highlights and shadow penumbrae.

Environment.description: The scene's image-based lighting and skybox (one per scene).
The environment map; null lights the scene with FallbackColor.

Intensity.description: The unitless strength of the image-based lighting.

Rotation.description: The rotation of the environment about the +Y axis, in degrees.

ShowSkybox.description: Whether cameras that clear to the skybox show the environment map.

SkyboxBlur.description: How blurred the visible skybox is, from sharp (0) to fully blurred (1).

FallbackColor.description: The linear ambient colour used when no environment map is assigned.

PostProcess.description: The scene's exposure, tone mapping, ambient occlusion, bloom and anti-aliasing (one per scene).

ExposureEV.description: The exposure compensation in stops: the image is multiplied by 2^EV.

SsaoEnabled.description: Whether screen-space ambient occlusion (GTAO) is applied. It darkens the environment's image-based light only (the Environment's FallbackColor ambient without a map), never direct lights.

SsaoRadius.description: The world-space radius within which ambient occlusion is sampled, in metres. An occluder further than this in front of a surface casts little occlusion on it: set it above the depth gap between the pieces and the surface behind them.

SsaoIntensity.description: The strength of the ambient occlusion, which darkens the environment's image-based light only, never direct lights.

BloomIntensity.description: How much of the bloom is blended into the image.

Text.description: Draws a text string on the screen or in the world.
The UTF-8 text; a line feed starts a new line.

Font.description: The font; null uses the default font.

Size.description: The em size. Screen space: pixels at the 1080p reference resolution, scaled by the viewport's height / 1080. World space: an em of Size / 100 metres (100 world-text pixels per metre) before the entity's scale, in the entity's local XY plane or facing the camera with Billboard, so the default 32 is 0.32 m.

Color.description: The linear text colour with opacity in the fourth component.

Space.description: Whether the text is placed on the screen or in the world.

Anchor.description: Screen space: the point of the viewport the text is placed at, normalized: (0, 0) is the top-left corner and (1, 1) the bottom-right, X to the right and Y down; (0.5, 0.5) is the centre.

Pivot.description: The point of the text block that sits on the anchor (Screen space) or at the entity's origin (World space), normalized to the block: (0, 0) is its top-left corner and (1, 1) its bottom-right.

Offset.description: Screen space: a further offset from the anchor in pixels at the 1080p reference resolution (scaled with the viewport's height), X to the right and Y down.

Alignment.description: How the lines are aligned to each other.

Billboard.description: Whether world-space text always faces the camera.

RigidBody.description: Simulates the entity with Jolt physics.

Type.description: Static never moves; Kinematic is moved by script; Dynamic is simulated.

Friction.description: The friction coefficient of the body's surfaces. A contact uses the geometric mean of both bodies' values, so 0 on one body removes friction from all its contacts.

Restitution.description: Bounciness, from no bounce (0) to a perfectly elastic bounce (1). A contact uses the larger of both bodies' values, so 1 on a ball makes it bounce elastically off every surface.

LinearDamping.description: How quickly linear velocity decays, per second.

AngularDamping.description: How quickly angular velocity decays, per second.

GravityFactor.description: The multiplier of the project's gravity for this body (0 floats).

AllowSleeping.description: Whether the body may sleep when it comes to rest.

LockTranslation.description: Per world axis: whether the body cannot move along it.

LockRotation.description: Per world axis: whether the body cannot rotate about it.

Layer.description: Physics layer name from project settings.

MaxLinearVelocity.description: The speed the body is clamped to, in metres per second.

MaxAngularVelocity.description: The angular speed the body is clamped to, in radians per second; raise it for fast rolling balls.

EnhancedInternalEdgeRemoval.description: Removes ghost collisions with internal edges of compound shapes; set it on rolling bodies.

InitialLinearVelocity.description: The world-space velocity the body starts with, in metres per second.

InitialAngularVelocity.description: The world-space angular velocity the body starts with, in radians per second.

BoxCollider.description: A box-shaped collider in the entity's space.

HalfExtents.description: Half the box's size along each local axis, in metres; at least 1 mm.

Offset.description: The box centre relative to the entity, in metres.

Rotation.description: The box rotation relative to the entity: a unit quaternion.

IsTrigger.description: Whether the collider only detects overlaps instead of colliding.

SphereCollider.description: A sphere-shaped collider in the entity's space.

Radius.description: The sphere radius, in metres; at least 1 mm.

Offset.description: The sphere centre relative to the entity, in metres.

IsTrigger.description: Whether the collider only detects overlaps instead of colliding.

CapsuleCollider.description: A capsule-shaped collider along the local Y axis.

Radius.description: The radius of the capsule's hemispheres and cylinder, in metres; at least 1 mm.

HalfHeight.description: Half the height of the cylinder between the hemispheres, in metres; at least 1 mm.

Offset.description: The capsule centre relative to the entity, in metres.

Rotation.description: The capsule rotation relative to the entity: a unit quaternion.

IsTrigger.description: Whether the collider only detects overlaps instead of colliding.

MeshCollider.description: A collider shaped like a mesh: its convex hull, or the exact triangles for Static and Kinematic bodies.

Mesh.description: The collision mesh; null uses the entity's MeshRenderer mesh.

Convex.description: Whether the convex hull is used; a non-convex mesh collider needs a Static or Kinematic body.

IsTrigger.description: Whether the collider only detects overlaps instead of colliding.

CharacterController.description: Moves the entity as a walking character that climbs steps and slopes and collides with the world.

Height.description: The character's total height, in metres.

Radius.description: The radius of the character's capsule, in metres.

MaxSlopeAngle.description: The steepest slope the character can walk up, in degrees.

StepHeight.description: The highest step the character climbs without jumping, in metres.

Mass.description: The character's mass in kilograms, used when it pushes bodies.

GravityFactor.description: The multiplier of the project's gravity for the character.

Layer.description: Physics layer name from project settings.

AudioSource.description: Plays an audio clip, optionally positioned at the entity.

Clip.description: The audio clip to play; null plays nothing.

Volume.description: The linear volume multiplier (1 is the clip's own level).

Pitch.description: The playback speed and pitch multiplier (1 is unchanged).

Loop.description: Whether the clip restarts when it ends.

PlayOnStart.description: Whether the clip starts playing when the play session starts.

Spatial.description: Whether the sound is positioned at the entity and attenuated with distance.

MinDistance.description: The distance within which the sound plays at full volume, in metres.

MaxDistance.description: The distance beyond which the sound stops getting quieter, in metres.

Attenuation.description: The distance attenuation model of a spatial sound.

Rolloff.description: How quickly the attenuation model falls off (1 is the model's own rate).

DopplerFactor.description: The strength of the Doppler pitch shift (0 disables it).

Group.description: The mixer group the sound plays in.

AudioListener.description: Hears the scene from the entity's position and orientation.

Primary.description: Whether this listener is used; with several primaries the first in canonical order wins, without any the primary camera listens.

Script.description: Attaches a Behaviour script to the entity (one per entity).

Fields.description: Overrides of the script's declared fields by name, each checked against the field's declared type; an unknown or mismatching override is kept and reported, and the field uses its declared default.

ExecutionOrder.description: The script's place in callback order: lower values run first, ties in canonical entity order.

PrefabOverride.description: One recorded difference between a prefab instance and its prefab.

PrefabEntityID.description: The prefab-local ID of the entity the override applies to (never the derived instance ID).

Kind.description: What the override changes: a field, an added or removed component, or an entity key.

Component.description: The registry name of the component for Field, AddComponent and RemoveComponent; empty for EntityKey.

Field.description: The field name for Field; Name, Active or Tags for EntityKey; empty otherwise.

Value.description: The overriding value, checked against the schema of its target: the field, the whole component, or the entity key.

Entity.description: One entity: its entity keys, then its components.

ID.description: The entity's id: 16 hex digits, unique within the file.

Parent.description: The parent entity's id, or null for a root.

Active.description: Whether the entity itself is active.

Components.description: The entity's components keyed by registry name; unknown components are preserved on save (§6), so they are allowed.
